teaser.en: Africa's leopard orchid: big clumps of cane-like stems high in a tree, and sprays of yellow flowers spotted brown.
teaser.sw: Okidi chui wa Afrika: makundi makubwa ya mashina kama miwa juu ya mti, na mashada ya maua ya manjano yenye madoa ya kahawia.
teaser.dg: *Chiahira* hino ni *leopard orchid* ya Afrika: mafungu makulu ga mihi dza miwa dzulu ya muhi, na milita mire ya maruwa ga rangi ya mandano genye mabara ga rangi ya dongo.

summary.en: The leopard orchid is a large epiphyte that grows in big clumps on tree trunks and branches. Digo include it under *chiahira*, their single name for every plant that 'sits on' another.
summary.sw: Okidi chui (*leopard orchid*) ni mmea mkubwa unaoishi juu ya mimea mingine, unaoota kwa makundi makubwa kwenye vigogo na matawi ya miti. Wadigo humweka chini ya *chiahira*, jina lao moja kwa kila mmea 'unaokaa juu' ya mwingine.
summary.dg: *Chiahira* hino (*leopard orchid*) ni mmea mkulu unaosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na inamera kpwa mafungu makulu dzulu ya makolo na panda za mihi. Adigo anaiika kahi ya *chiahira*, dzina rao rimwenga ra chila mmea 'unaosagala dzulu' ya mimea yanjina.

about.en: The leopard orchid is one of Africa's largest orchids. It forms dense clumps of tall, cane-like stems with leathery leaves. Beneath the clump grows a tangle of upright, spiky roots that catch falling leaves and debris. Its long sprays of flowers are yellow with brown leopard-like spots, which is where the English name comes from.
about.sw: Okidi chui ni mmoja wa okidi wakubwa zaidi barani Afrika. Hutengeneza makundi mazito ya mashina marefu kama miwa yenye majani magumu kama ngozi. Chini ya kundi hilo huota mizizi iliyosongamana, iliyosimama wima na yenye ncha kama miiba, inayonasa majani yanayoanguka na takataka. Mashada yake marefu ya maua ni ya manjano yenye madoa ya kahawia kama ya chui, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kiingereza linapotoka.
about.dg: *Chiahira* hino ni mwenga wa *orchid* kulu zaidi za Afrika. Inahenda mafungu ga mihi mire minji phamwenga, dza miwa, yenye makodza magumu dza chingo. Photsi ya fungu kunamera mizi minji iimayo chocho, yenye ntsa dza miya, iriyotsanganyikana, na inagbwira makodza ganayogbwa na vifusi. Maruwage ganamera kpwa milita mire, ni ga rangi ya mandano genye mabara ga rangi ya dongo dza ga tsui, na ndiko dzina ra Chingereza rinakotuluka.

where.en: It grows on trees in woodland, coastal forest and bush across tropical and southern Africa, often high in the crown of large trees.
where.sw: Huota juu ya miti katika misitu, misitu ya pwani na vichaka kote katika Afrika ya kitropiki na kusini mwa Afrika, mara nyingi juu kabisa katika taji za miti mikubwa.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya mihi weruni, matsakani ga pwani na vitsakani, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho na kusini mwa Afrika, mara nyinji dzulu sana ya mihi mikulu.

culture.en: *Chiahira* means 'sitting on', from *ahira*, the word for a hen sitting on her eggs. The orchid perches on its host tree like a brooding hen. The *chi-* prefix is a diminutive, since most epiphytes are small.
culture.sw: *Chiahira* lina maana ya 'kukaa juu ya', kutokana na *ahira*, neno la kuku anayeatamia mayai yake. Okidi huyu hukaa juu ya mti unaombeba kama kuku anayeatamia. Kiambishi *chi-* ni cha udogo, kwa kuwa mimea mingi ya aina hii ni midogo.
culture.dg: *Chiahira* rina mana ya 'kusagala dzulu', kula kpwa *ahira*, neno ra kuku anayesagala dzulu ya matumbige. *Orchid* hino inasagala dzulu ya muhi inaoumera dza kuku anayeahira. Mwandzo *chi-* unaonyesa kukala chitu ni chidide, kpwa sababu mimea minji inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina ni midide.

names.en: Pakia records the name *chiahira* for this orchid and for the smaller *Angraecum dives*. The Digo use *chiahira* for all epiphytes as one group and do not separate the species by name. Mgombato's Swahili gloss for *chiahira* is *kimelea*, a general term for such plants.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina *chiahira* kwa okidi huyu na kwa *Angraecum dives* aliye mdogo zaidi. Wadigo hutumia *chiahira* kwa mimea yote inayoishi juu ya mimea mingine kama kundi moja na hawazitenganishi spishi kwa majina. Tafsiri ya Kiswahili ya Mgombato kwa *chiahira* ni *kimelea*, neno la jumla kwa mimea kama hii.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina *chiahira* kpwa *orchid* hino na kpwa *Angraecum dives*, iriyo ndide zaidi. Adigo anahumira *chiahira* kpwa mimea yosi inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina dza fungu rimwenga, na taaganya aina zao kpwa madzina. Kpwa Chiswahili, Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kukala ni *kimelea*, neno ra mimea yosi ya aina hino.

conservation.en: Elsewhere in Africa the leopard orchid is heavily collected for the medicinal plant trade and for gardens, and it has declined in many places. Like all orchids it is listed on CITES Appendix II.
conservation.sw: Kwingineko barani Afrika, okidi chui huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya biashara ya mimea ya dawa na kwa bustani, na amepungua katika maeneo mengi. Kama okidi wote, ameorodheshwa katika Kiambatisho II cha CITES.
conservation.dg: Phatu phanjina Afrika, *chiahira* hino nkutsolwa sana kpwa biashara ya mimea ya dawa na kpwa kuphandwa busitanini, na phatu phanji ikasala chidide. Dza *orchid* zosi, ikaandikpwa kpwenye CITES Appendix II.

reason.en: Mistletoe, another plant that lives on trees
reason.sw: Kimelea (*mistletoe*), mmea mwingine unaoishi juu ya miti
reason.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo*, mmea wanjina unaoishi dzulu ya mihi
Mmea unaomera dzulu ya mihi na kuifyondza

reason.en: Large forest tree of the kind epiphytes grow on
reason.sw: Mti mkubwa wa msitu wa aina ambayo mimea hii huota juu yake
reason.dg: Muhi mkulu wa tsakani, wa aina ambayo mimea inayosagala dzulu ya mihi inamera dzuluye

mgombato: chiahira (vi) parasitical plant whose leaves are bruised and made into twists to be inserted into the ear as medicine for earache; kimelea chenye majani ambayo yanayofyandwa na kuingizwa sikioni kama dawa ya maumivu ya sikioni.
